claims.title: The chart wall — ten kinds, all native
notes: ten charts lowered as 99 native path(s) and 102 label frame(s); stacked-column, stacked-bar and radar are the 2026-08 kind-set additions that make the set a superset of Illustrator's nine

claims.title: The native pour
notes: showGridInFrame painted the live grid into the lowered frame (C-1 scene layer), and hideGridInFrame cleared it — demonstrated, not resident: session state never reaches the checkpoint

claims.title: A day-book across the gutter
notes: wire-shape finding: insert bounds are PAGE-local; resizeFrame bounds are SPREAD-space (spine at x 0, verso negative) — a page-local resize walks a verso frame onto the recto while it stays parented to its own page
the hit test answered the frame's story but no table-cell context at its centre, so the header band could not be added — tables.header-footer-repeat is NOT claimed by this page
